quality_metrics.note: Reconciles the original write-up's flagged 'unverified, possibly inflated' ROCE (~47.8%) and growth (~65.7%) figures using screener.in's FY-labelled tables: the real ROCE trend is 9-12% (FY20-22) improving to a genuine 21-24% (FY23-25) - strong but not the ~48% cited; the ~65.7% growth figure is CONFIRMED, not an artifact (FY24 was actually +65.8%). OPM has been remarkably stable (~9-10%) across 8 fiscal years. FCF conversion is thin (~1% of EBITDA, FY26) as capex absorbs most operating cash flow. Separately: promoter holding fell 66.50% (Mar-26) -> 61.48% (Jul-26), a fresh ~5pp reduction the original write-up (which only checked encumbrance, not the raw holding %) did not have visibility into.

track_record.note: FY23 (+16.0% growth, ROCE 21%), FY24 (+65.8%, ROCE 24%) and FY25 (+40.9%, ROCE 24%) each cleared BOTH >=10% revenue growth AND >=15% ROCE; FY20-22 did not clear (ROCE only 9-12% in that window). A genuine, recent 3-year step-up in consistency.
